answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the knoll queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 480 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the relic. The oasis index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 215 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
